brief:
A 10-year-old boy, Qusay al-Joulani, was shot dead by an unknown gunman at the entrance to an UNRWA school in Shufat refugee camp in occupied East Jerusalem, Shehab Wire reported. The shooting occurred as the child arrived at the school's entrance.

Shufat camp, located northeast of Jerusalem's Old City, is home to thousands of Palestinian refugees. The incident marks another outbreak of gun violence in the densely populated camp.

title: Child killed in shooting at Shufat refugee camp school
